run_package_in_onedocker: run a package in a OneDocker container by downloading the executable from S3 and executing it with args
download_executable_from_s3: download an executable from an S3 repository path to a local folder for a given package and version
run_opawdl_workflow: run a pre-defined OPA workflow using the OPAWDL driver with a unique instance ID and workflow path
build_executable_command: build a shell command string from an executable path and optional arguments using shlex split and join
prepare_executable_for_run: prepare an executable by downloading it from S3 or using a local repository and setting execute permissions
